verified_facts.text: The hotel stands beside Piazza Duca d'Aosta and Milano Centrale station.
verified_facts.excerpt: Excelsior Hotel Gallia stands beside Piazza Duca d’Aosta and Milano Centrale station

verified_facts.text: Lake Como, Venice and Florence are a train journey away from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: From the hotel, iconic destinations such as Lake Como, Venice, and Florence are just a convenient train journey away

verified_facts.text: The hotel was founded by Carlo Gallia, who spent 15 years working in hotels across Europe before founding it.
verified_facts.excerpt: He remained abroad for the next 15 years, working in several different European locales (London, Paris, Berlin, Lucerne, Monte Carlo, and St. Moritz). Upon returning to Milan with a wealth of experience, he founded our beloved property.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a collection of more than 500 art pieces, including paintings, sculptures and photographs, designed by Studio Marco Piva exclusively for the property.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover our unique collection of more than 500 art pieces designed by Studio Marco Piva exclusively for the property, too. These include paintings, sculptures and photographs.

verified_facts.text: All of the hotel's furniture is made in Italy, with several pieces produced with Milanese artisans and designers.
verified_facts.excerpt: All of Excelsior Hotel Gallia’s furniture is Made in Italy, with several pieces produced in collaboration with Milanese artisans and designers.

verified_facts.text: Rooms feature handcrafted and modern elements by local ateliers including B&B Italia, Cassina, Fendi Casa and Flos.
verified_facts.excerpt: boasting a seamless blend of handcrafted and modern elements meticulously curated by local ateliers such as B&B Italia, Cassina, Fendi Casa and Flos

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms showcase Botticino or Emperador marble with Belle Epoque bronze accents.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bathrooms showcase Botticino or Emperador marble set against Belle Époque bronze accents.

verified_facts.text: Atelier Suites are conceived as art galleries, with unique lighting and colour use.
verified_facts.excerpt: our Atelier Suites are conceived as art galleries, upping the theatricality ante with unique lighting and colour use

verified_facts.text: Signature Suites take inspiration from Italian creators such as Gio Ponti and Castiglioni, and many feature their designs.
verified_facts.excerpt: our Signature Suites are infused with inspiration from world renowned Italian creators such as Gio Ponti and Castiglioni–many feature their designs

verified_facts.text: The Katara Royal Suite is a four-bedroom suite on the seventh floor with two terraces.
verified_facts.excerpt: This unique four-bedroom suite, located on the seventh floor, redefines Milanese grandeur. Elevating the experience are two expansive terraces

verified_facts.text: The Katara Royal Suite has a terrace with a private solarium housing a pagoda spa with a whirlpool.
verified_facts.excerpt: the other offering a private solarium housing a pagoda spa, equipped with a whirlpool and a chromotherapy enhanced steam shower

verified_facts.text: Panoramic Suites have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of landmarks and the cityscape.
verified_facts.excerpt: these suites present breathtaking views of landmarks and the cityscape through expansive floor-to-ceiling windows

verified_facts.text: Many rooms have direct views over Piazza Duca d'Aosta.
verified_facts.excerpt: Many of our family hotel's rooms hold direct views over the Piazza Duca d'Aosta.

verified_facts.text: The Gallia Health Club and Shiseido Spa Milan spans two floors, the sixth and seventh, with panoramic views of the historic city center.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled on the sixth and seventh floors of the Excelsior Hotel Gallia, the 1,000-square-meter Gallia Health Club & Shiseido Spa Milan combines the prestige of the premier Shiseido brand with panoramic views of the historic city center.

verified_facts.text: The wellness center has a Himalayan salt cabin, hydrotherapy sessions, wet and dry saunas and a steam room.
verified_facts.excerpt: amenities such as a Himalayan salt cabin, hydrotherapy sessions, wet and dry saunas and a steam room

verified_facts.text: Therapists at the Shiseido Spa specialize in Japanese wellness rituals.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled within the Center is the exclusive Shiseido Spa, where expert therapists specialize in centuries-old Japanese wellness rituals.

verified_facts.text: The Private Spa Suite has a treatment room for two, a jacuzzi, sauna, steam room, ice room and relaxation area.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Private Spa Suite features a treatment room for two, jacuzzi, sauna, steam room, ice room, and a serene relaxation area

verified_facts.text: The indoor pool is on the seventh floor and has panoramic views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perched on the seventh floor of the Excelsior Hotel Gallia, the exclusive indoor pool invites guests to slow down and savor a serene interlude; an oasis of calm where refined ambiance and panoramic views

verified_facts.text: The fitness area on the seventh floor is equipped with Technogym machines.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the seventh floor of the Excelsior Hotel Gallia, the fitness area is equipped with the most modern machines by Technogym.

verified_facts.text: The seventh floor of the hotel offers a panoramic view over Piazza Duca d'Aosta.
verified_facts.excerpt: Admire the panoramic view over the capital of fashion from the 7th floor of Excelsior Hotel Gallia; you will marvel at the landscape of Piazza Duca D’Aosta

verified_facts.text: The hotel's wine cellar holds over 700 labels.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Excelsior Hotel Gallia boasts a wine cellar comprising over 700 labels from the finest vintages worldwide.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers cooking classes led by its chef, covering Italian classics or the hotel's signature dishes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enhance your culinary expertise under the guidance of our talented chef as you choose between mastering timeless Italian classics or exploring the hotel’s signature creations.

verified_facts.text: The head concierge is a member of Les Clefs d'Or.
verified_facts.excerpt: Meet our head concierge, proud member of 'Les Clefs d'Or'.

verified_facts.text: Piazza Gae Aulenti and the Porta Nuova district are within walking distance.
verified_facts.excerpt: Piazza Gae Aulenti and the modern district of Porta Nuova are located at walking distance

verified_facts.text: The Cigar Lounge recreates the classic smoking rooms of Milan's grand railway stations.
verified_facts.excerpt: Since its opening, Excelsior Hotel Gallia has nurtured a tradition of recreating the classic smoking rooms found in Milan’s grand railway stations.

verified_facts.text: One pet is allowed per room, within a weight limit.
verified_facts.excerpt: One pet is allowed per room, with a maximum weight of 39.0 lbs.

verified_facts.text: Brera, the Duomo, Sforzesco Castle and La Scala are described as within walking distance.
verified_facts.excerpt: Most renowned cultural attractions at walking distance: Brera, Duomo, Sforzesco Castle, La Scala

Our crowning jewel, the Katara Royal Suite, reigns as one of the largest in Europe, spanning an impressive 1000 square meters.
